title: PARTIAL — Package 13 Wave 10 scripted performance
binding: The 169-file capture snapshot includes 43 Source files, 3 Config files, 120 Content files, 2 capture/analyzer scripts and the project. Raw hashes match the retained Package 13 audit, which compared the inputs with immutable commit a628c7faa3d6c160ded22981bd3c230cb0cbf203. Source preservation is recorded by the wrapper completion guard; the full before snapshot is retained. This receipt does not rebind any Package 12 measurements.

method.parser: Independent Python standard-library CSV parsing using the final EVENTS header. Both header rows and the metadata footer are excluded. Exact FrameTime, GPUTime, GameThreadTime, RenderThreadTime and RHIThreadTime counters are used.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]; median averages the middle pair. Threshold counts are strictly greater than 16.667/33.333/50 ms. Final rounded comparison tolerance is 1.1e-6.
method.recalculation: All seven analyzer groups, foreground markers, kind counts, phase timings, caps and compound presence were recomputed from raw rows and matched. Neither the CSV nor retained analysis was modified.
method.settings: Win64 Development, 2560x1440, DX12/SM6, all 11 scalability groups at 2, VSync off, 120 FPS cap, audio enabled. Intel i7-14700F and NVIDIA RTX 5080. MaxFrameTime 8.3333 ms is the requested budget, not measured frame time.
method.timing: Normal actual engine frames and Actor DeltaSeconds. Fixture guards reject fixed timestep, fixed frame rate and effective time dilation other than 1. Existing timers, 40 s climax, threat caps, budgets, spatial admission and damage remain enabled.
method.processes: Wrapper reports successful normal exit 0. Independent process read confirmed owned PID 106548 is absent. This audit launched no game or engine.
method.readback: Capture flags and visualRequests show no in-game screenshot/readback; no PNGs or screenshot log markers exist. Startup before CSV recording is not measured.

host_activity.provenance: Lead-reported operational context; no independent process-history instrumentation.
host_activity.overlap: No build, Blender or indexing overlapped capture. Owner Editor 66256 and ordinary desktop apps remained open; this was not a clean benchmark host.
host_activity.window_activity: Lead activated the window and used text state only; no screenshot was used during this capture.

capture.fixture_description: Fixed seed 5eade000000000000000000000000010; starter/RapidLaser; five Tier V paths; OverdriveCooling; base hull/shield 50000; seeded end of Wave8; no contract/events. Normal wave timings, 40s climax, caps, budgets, spatial admission and damage. Scripted shallow strafe, boost/brake cycles, dodge/8s and fire2s/6s. Kind presence includes telegraphs/offscreen actors. No station docking or natural balance/input/feel acceptance.

conclusion: The final fairness package maintained the 120 FPS cap closely through this scripted Wave 10 load. No marked frame exceeded 16.667 ms. This supports integrated endgame performance on this machine; the representative 60 FPS acceptance gate remains open.
limitations: One seeded run starting at the end of Wave 8 with Tier V starter/RapidLaser/OverdriveCooling and 50000 base hull/shield; no natural full 10-wave run, balanced survival or urge-to-retry acceptance.
Controls call ordinary flight, boost/brake, dodge and weapon APIs through a scripted fixture. This does not test physical keyboard/controller latency or subjective flight quality.
Actor counts include offscreen threats and warning states; no visibility, aiming readability or visual-art acceptance is inferred.

No Station 1 or Station 2 services, natural station interactions, menu purchases or contracts are exercised by this Wave 10-only capture. Earlier Package 12 station/performance evidence remains historical.
Audio was enabled but listening and mix acceptance were not performed.
One RTX 5080 system at 1440p quality 2 and a 120 FPS cap; no lower-tier hardware, uncapped headroom, clean-PC compatibility or representative hardware coverage.
